_note: Field probe: a short bare wire or metal plate exposed to the electric fields of the room. 1-terminal: a. Engine (bw-board field_probe): a knob control 0..1, how close the field source is. params.source picks the source: 'mains' (a live cable in the wall, mainsVolts/mainsHz), 'charge' (a rubbed ruler at rodVolts) or 'body' (the learner's finger, contact 'skin' through skinOhms or 'paper' through paperFarads); maxFarads is the coupling at the closest approach, strayFarads the wire's own capacitance to the room, adaptorFarads > 0 means the circuit runs from a mains adaptor. Drawn as a bare copper wire with a stripped tip and a field symbol.
